description: E32 — 用Bb4破坏白方协调体系

intro.popup_en:
Piece Coordination, Practice 7
Learn to disrupt the opponent's coordination. With ...Bb4, one bishop pins Nc3 and can make White's entire setup difficult to coordinate.
intro.popup:
子力协调第7局
学会破坏对方协调！
Bb4牵制Nc3，一枚象让白方整个协调体系"卡壳"

outro.popup_en: Summary: understanding coordination helps you recognize how to disrupt it. Targeting the key knight on c3 forces the opponent to rebuild the coordination of the pieces.
outro.popup:
总结：理解协调，才能知道如何破坏它
破坏关键枢纽马（Nc3），让对方重建协调

moves.popup: d4占中心
moves.popup_en: d4 occupies the center.

moves.popup: Nf6防御d4
moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops and attacks d4.

moves.popup: c4后翼弃兵
moves.popup_en: c4 offers the Queen's Gambit pawn.

moves.popup: e6防御
moves.popup_en: ...e6 supports Black's center.

moves.popup:
Nc3！白方协调枢纽马
激活：Nc3是白方协调的关键
协调：Nc3控d5+e4，是白方中心的"大梁"
moves.popup_en: Nc3! This is White's coordination hub: the knight controls d5 and e4 and forms a key support for the center.

moves.popup:
Bb4！！黑方精彩一击！
激活：象直接牵制Nc3！
破坏：Nc3被牵制后，
  → 不能自由跳入d5/e4
  → 不能支援c4兵
  → 白方整个协调体系卡壳！
这就是"破坏协调"的典型战术！
moves.popup_en: ...Bb4!! A strong tactical idea: the bishop pins Nc3. The knight can no longer freely jump to d5 or e4 or support c4, disrupting White's entire coordination.

moves.popup:
Qc2白方反制！
激活：后早出，为何？
计划：Qc2防止Bxc3+后重吃，
  若Bxc3+ Qxc3不损失双兵结构
注意：白方被迫过早出后——这是被破坏协调后的代价！
moves.popup_en: Qc2 counters the pin and prepares to recapture with the queen if ...Bxc3+. White is forced to develop the queen early; that loss of time is part of the cost of having the coordination disrupted.

moves.popup:
O-O黑方易位
黑方稳健王安全
moves.popup_en: ...O-O secures Black's king.

moves.popup:
a3！白方逼象表态
激活：强迫Bb4离开或换马
计划：若Bxc3+，Qxc3重新控中心
白方接受换马，尝试重建协调
moves.popup_en: a3! White asks the bishop to decide: retreat or exchange the knight. If ...Bxc3+, Qxc3 restores central control, so White accepts the exchange and begins rebuilding coordination.

moves.popup:
Bxc3+！黑方执行换马
破坏：Nc3被换掉！
代价分析：
  ✅ 黑方：换掉白方协调枢纽马
  ❌ 白方：Nc3消失，d5/e4控制力减弱
  ❌ 白方：双兵结构后可能受损
moves.popup_en: ...Bxc3+! Black carries out the exchange and removes White's coordination hub. White loses some control of d5 and e4 and may also acquire doubled pawns.

moves.popup:
Qxc3重新夺回
激活：后收回Nc3的控制功能
协调重建开始：Qc3+Bg5+Nf3
但后在c3过于靠前，仍有弊端
moves.popup_en: Qxc3 recaptures and restores some of the knight's control. White starts rebuilding with Qc3, Bg5, and Nf3, though the queen may be exposed on c3.

moves.popup:
b6黑方准备出象
黑方扩展空间
moves.popup_en: ...b6 prepares to develop the bishop and expands Black's queenside space.

moves.popup:
Bg5白方重建！
激活：象出动牵制Nf6
协调重建：Bg5（换走Nc3后的替代协调子）
计划：Bg5+Nf3联合，部分恢复对e5/d5的压力
moves.popup_en: Bg5 begins White's rebuild. The bishop pins Nf6 and partly replaces the coordination role lost with Nc3; together with Nf3 it restores pressure on e5 and d5.

moves.popup:
Bb7黑方象出动
激活：Bb7控制g2-a8大斜线
协调：Bb7与Nf6联合，黑方协调稳固
moves.popup_en: ...Bb7 develops along the long diagonal, coordinating with Nf6 to give Black a sound setup.

moves.popup:
Nf3白方马出来
激活：第2个马
协调：Nf3（控e5）+ Bg5（牵制f6）+ Qc3（控中心）
白方协调在重建中
moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops White's second knight. Nf3 controls e5, Bg5 pins Nf6, and Qc3 influences the center as White continues rebuilding coordination.

moves.popup: d6黑方守中心
moves.popup_en: ...d6 reinforces Black's center.

moves.popup:
e3稳固
激活：开放象斜线
moves.popup_en: e3 supports the center and opens a diagonal for the bishop.

moves.popup:
Nbd7黑方第2马
守备且准备...e5反击
moves.popup_en: ...Nbd7 develops the second knight, reinforces the position, and prepares ...e5.

moves.popup:
Be2象守备
激活：象到e2，准备易位
协调：Be2支援Nf3，稳固中心
moves.popup_en: Be2 prepares White to castle and supports Nf3, helping stabilize the center.

moves.popup:
Re8黑方车进e列
激活：车激活，准备...e5推进
moves.popup_en: ...Re8 activates the rook on the e-file and prepares the ...e5 break.

moves.popup:
O-O白方终于易位
激活：Rf1进入游戏
协调恢复：易位后双车可联结
moves.popup_en: O-O finally secures White's king and activates the rook on f1. Castling helps reconnect the rooks.

moves.popup:
e5！黑方中路爆发
激活：黑方利用白方协调被破坏的时间差反击！
计划：e5后d4弱，黑方主动
moves.popup_en: ...e5! Black uses the time White spent rebuilding coordination to strike in the center and target d4, seizing the initiative.

moves.popup: dxe5白方吃兵
moves.popup_en: dxe5 captures the pawn.

moves.popup:
dxe5黑方吃回
开放局面
moves.popup_en: ...dxe5 recaptures and opens the position.

moves.popup:
Rfd1！车进d列
激活：白方车终于激活
协调修复：Rfd1+Qc3控d列
但是……对比Practice 006，白方缺少Rc1的早期战略准备
moves.popup_en: Rfd1! White finally activates a rook and coordinates it with Qc3 on the d-file. Compared with Practice 006, however, White missed the early strategic preparation with Rc1.

moves.popup:
Qe7黑方后联结
黑方后+车+马协调
moves.popup_en: ...Qe7 connects Black's queen with the rook and knight.

moves.popup:
Rd2车到d2
激活：车在d2支援
教训：白方最终重建了协调，但付出了时间代价
黑方Bb4破坏协调后，黑方主动争取到了...e5反击！
✅ 结论：破坏对方协调是高价值战术
moves.popup_en: Rd2 supports the position, but White has spent time rebuilding coordination. Black's ...Bb4 disrupted White's setup and created the opportunity for the active ...e5 counterstrike: disrupting coordination can be highly valuable.
